Quarterly consultations with a diabetes nurse remain routine, complemented by a recently finished six-session physiotherapy regimen for mechanical lower back pain. Chronic shoulder discomfort is also monitored through a specialized pain clinic. Widowed, he shares a home with his partner and maintains a flexible timetable that easily accommodates his outpatient visits.
